# Brilliant Mind Travels & Tours

Brilliant Mind Travels & Tours is a travel and educational consultancy based in Ede South, Osun State, Nigeria.

## Business Information

- Business name: Brilliant Mind Travels & Tours
- Location: Ede South, Osun State, Nigeria
- Address: Beside Eyiowu Awi Pharmacy, Ede South, Osun State
- Phone/WhatsApp: +234 816 590 0571
- Email: brilliantmindtravels1@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.brilliantmindtravels.com/

## Main Services

- Visa guidance and consultancy
- Study abroad consultancy
- Flight booking
- Travel consultancy
- Tourism and tour packages
- Educational consultancy
